0.original: J'nasshym of the Brugaire Consortium seeks the services of a conveniently unoccupied adventurer.

1.original: J'nasshym of the Brugaire Consortium has tasked you with making a delivery─a gift parcel for services rendered─to the Dutiful Sisters of the Edelweiss. Head to the Sisters' “convent” found near Fisherman's Bottom, and hand the package directly to Lonwoerd.

2.original: You have delivered the package to Lonwoerd. Return to the Octant and speak with J'nasshym.

3.original: You return to J'nasshym and convey Lonwoerd's message. It would seem that the Dutiful Sisters are far more important to the continued well-being of Limsa Lominsa than their modest facade would indicate...

24.original: Deliver the package for the Dutiful Sisters to Lonwoerd.

48.original: Excuse me, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, but might you have a moment or two to spare? You seem the type who enjoys being accosted for menial tasks, and I require someone to make a delivery to the Dutiful Sisters of the Edelweiss.

49.original: I wouldn't be surprised if you hadn't heard of them─the Sisters prefer not to advertise their presence here in Limsa Lominsa.

50.original: They do, however, provide a rather <hex:021A020203>unique<hex:021A020103> service of which the Brugaire Consortium has recently been the beneficiary. I would have you deliver this package to their doorman, Lonwoerd, along with our profuse gratitude.

51.original: You'll find the Dutiful Sisters'...er, “convent” down near Fisherman's Bottom. Pray deliver the package to the doorman, along with the sincere gratitude of the Brugaire Consortium.

52.original: Aye, this's the Dutiful Sisters o' the Edelweiss─a house o' deep reflection an' meditation. So unless ye've proper business with us, ye can kindly bugger off.

53.original: Ho there, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Ye lookin' to head inside?

54.original: ...What's this, then? A parcel from the Brugaire Consortium, eh? Let's have a peek inside...

55.original: Oooh, walnut bread an' ginger cookies. ...An' a few o' them Bismarck finger sandwiches, too! Them Consortium culls know the right way to show appreciation!

56.original: Some o' them Sisters have unholy appetites, so I'd best save a few bites for meself afore I take this inside... Ahem. You let J'nasshym know we're always here should her boss have need of us again.

57.original: You've delivered the package as I requested? Very good. I shall pass on the Sisters' sentiments to my superior.

58.original: ...Hm? What manner of services do the Dutiful Sisters provide?

59.original: Continue your stay in Limsa Lominsa, and you'll likely find out soon enough. In fact, if you're confident in your abilities─and comfortable with the <hex:021A020203>unconventional<hex:021A020103>─you might wish to approach them yourself...

60.original: I'm quite sure an adventurer of your stature has already glimpsed the truth behind the facade. For a business such as ours, their presence in the city is incredibly reassuring!
